canonical_title: Ejection seat air vehicle physical clearance

versions.title_at_revision: Ejection seat air vehicle physical clearance
versions.text:
Standard: There is no encroachment of a spherical volume with a 4.0 ft radius, centered about the ejected mass CG position, following this minimum clearance being attained for the first time, post air vehicle separation. Ejection seat components (e.g., deployed stabilization system) maintain a minimum clearance of 12 inches from any air vehicle or canopy structure following this minimum clearance being attained for the first time. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Ejection testing will be performed to verify the trajectory of the ejection seat and ejection seat components.
